headline: Disney offered a 13-year-old $2M to sing in ‘The Lion King’ — 25x his last paycheck. His mom said no
summary: Jason Weaver's mom rejected Disney's $2M upfront offer for “The Lion King” in the early '90s — negotiating royalties instead. More than 30 years later, the checks are still coming.

headline: Disney offers $20M to AI company facing bankruptcy, lawsuits claiming its chatbot encouraged kids to hurt themselves
summary: Character.AI has settled teen suicide lawsuits and faces a Kentucky AG suit alleging its chatbots encouraged self-harm — now Disney wants its IP for $20 million.

headline: Disney to Spend $60 Million a Year on Character.AI Talent After Its Own Layoffs as AI Startup Faces Bankruptcy
summary: Disney plans to spend $60 million annually on 66 Character.AI employees despite recent layoffs as its AI strategy expands.
